title: Lucia's Actress Confirmed Before GTA 6 Launch
short_title: Lucia's actress is CONFIRMED before launch #GTA6 #Shorts
short_description: Manni L. Perez is officially Lucia in GTA 6: The Game Awards 2026 nominated her for Best Performance on November 17, two days before launch. short.headline: Lucia's actress confirmed
short.text: Lucia's actress is finally confirmed, two days before GTA 6 even comes out.
short.text_es: La actriz de Lucía por fin está confirmada, dos días antes de que salga GTA 6.

short.headline: Manni L. Perez
short.text: It's Manni L. Perez, the name fans guessed from the very first trailer. The Game Awards just nominated her for Best Performance.
short.text_es: Es Manni L. Perez, el nombre que los fans adivinaron desde el primer tráiler. The Game Awards la acaba de nominar a Mejor Actuación.

short.headline: 8 nominations
short.text: And GTA 6 got eight nominations, including Game of the Year, before anyone has even played it.
short.text_es: Y GTA 6 recibió ocho nominaciones, incluido Juego del Año, antes de que alguien lo haya jugado.

short.headline: Who plays Jason?
short.text: Jason's actor still hasn't been revealed. So who plays Jason? Because Lucia's actress
short.text_es: El actor de Jason todavía no se ha revelado. ¿Quién interpreta a Jason? Porque la actriz de Lucía
